composiohq/composio.caption:
How to build AI Agents that actually work in real life 👇

AI Agents are nothing without APP CONNECTORS.

You can build the smartest AI agent, but if it can't connect to Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Calendar - it's useless for real work.

Manually integrating each app takes WEEKS - OAuth, API
